title: Which Platform Changed?
prerequisites: Can recognise train, platform, and boarding
objective: Find destination, exception, platform, and boarding-time evidence in a station notice, then state the current travel details.

scenario.notice: COAST LINE — Saturday 28 September. The 14:20 train to Saint-Pierre usually leaves from platform 2. Today only, it leaves from platform 5. Boarding closes at 14:15.
scenario.traveller_need: Find the platform used today and the boarding deadline.

model.evidence: Today only, it leaves from platform 5. Boarding closes at 14:15.
model.statement: The 14:20 train to Saint-Pierre leaves from platform 5 today. Boarding closes at 14:15.
model.meaning_note: Usually gives the normal platform. Today only marks an exception. Boarding closes gives the last boarding time, not departure time.
model.grammar_note: Use leaves from + platform. Use at + clock time. Add today when the notice marks an exception.
model.appropriateness_note: Check the destination and date first. State both platform and boarding time when helping another traveller.

activities.prompt: Which platform should you use today?

options.feedback: Platform 2 is usual. Today only changes the train to platform 5.
The exception line says today only and names platform 5.
14:20 and 14:15 are times. No platform 14 appears.

activities.prompt: Which statement gives both current details?

options.feedback: This uses the usual platform and treats boarding time as departure time.

options.text: It leaves from platform 5 today. Boarding closes at 14:15.
options.feedback: This states the exception and keeps boarding separate from departure.
A clock time does not identify a platform.

transfer_task.scenario: An airport shuttle usually uses bay 3. A notice says: ‘Monday only: Bay 7. Boarding closes 08:40. Departure 08:45.’
transfer_task.instruction: Write two sentences for another traveller. State today's bay and boarding deadline.
acceptable_responses: The shuttle leaves from bay 7 today. Boarding closes at 08:40.
Use bay 7 on Monday. You must board by 08:40.

retrieval_prompt: Tomorrow, ask: Which words show the normal rule, the exception, and the boarding deadline?

visual.summary: A four-step evidence path: match destination, notice the exception, find the platform, then separate boarding and departure times.
visual.alt_text: Four layered paper cards lead from Saint-Pierre and today's exception to platform 5, then separate boarding at 14:15 from departure at 14:20.
visual.text_equivalent: MATCH DESTINATION -> FIND TODAY'S EXCEPTION -> USE PLATFORM 5 -> BOARD 14:15, DEPART 14:20

scenes.caption: Match destination and train.
scenes.motion: The destination card slides into the station board. The train arrives beside it.

scenes.caption: Find today's exception.
scenes.motion: Platform 2 folds away. A today-only strip reveals platform 5.

scenes.caption: Separate platform from time.
scenes.motion: The platform sign moves left. Two clocks move onto boarding and departure tracks.

scenes.caption: State the current details.
scenes.motion: The train moves toward platform 5. A summary ticket unfolds with both times.
